issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

batchAllScanningExpressions.description:
Whether or not to batch all of the {@link DataTagBase} instances that evaluate expressions on the same
{@link DataTag#srcType} and have a {@link DataTagBase#filter} which scans the whole table into the same batches.

scanningExpressionsBatchSize.description:
The size of the batches in terms of the number of instances of {@link DataTagBase#srcType} should be placed into
each batch of the {@link PopulateDataTagsBatchJob}

persistTagCountsAfterJob.description:
Whether or not {@link DataTagCountHistory}s should be persisted for each data tag after the {@link PopulateDataTagsBatchJob}
completes.

persistEnabledTagCountsOnly.description:
Whether or not data tags with {@link DataTagBase#enabled} set to true should be the only tags which have counts
persisted.

persistTagCountsAsynchronously.description:
Whether or not the persistence of the {@link DataTagCountHistory} instances should happen asynchronously for
each {@link DataTagBase#srcType} being tagged.

title:
Specifies the configuration of the {@link PopulateDataTagsBatchJob} such as how it wil schedule batches for {@link DataTagBase}
instances which each scan the entirety of a table for a {@link DataTagBase#srcType}.
name: PopulateDataTagsBatchJobConfig
